name: curated
description: Hand-curated vectors: each input is an excerpt of a real opinion, and each expected value was read against that opinion and the cited cases' records by a person. Owner rulings decide what the answer is; no engine's output is the reference. See README.md.
corpora: stare.pub: Caselaw Access Project case files from data.stare.pub/cap/<slug>/<volume>.zip (CC0 1.0), casebody.opinions[].text and case metadata
courtlistener-10pct (corpora/courtlistener-10pct.json, prepared by tools/fetch_corpus.py), for the vectors README.md lists as staying on it

provenance.note: Each expected value was read by hand against its excerpt and the cited cases' CAP records when the set was added (#32, owner ruling D50 of 2026-10-18). A vector whose own provenance says otherwise overrides this. Not yet verified by the maintainer.
